French

[edit]
French Wikipedia has an article on:
réaction
Wikipedia fr

Etymology

[edit]

Learned borrowing from Medieval Latin reactio.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ʁe.ak.sjɔ̃/
  • Audio:(file)
  • Audio (France (Paris)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Vosges)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Lyon)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Somain)):(file)

Noun

[edit]

réaction f (plural réactions)

  1. reaction (action in response to an event)
    en réaction à quelque chose ― (please add an English translation of this usage example)
    réaction en chaîne ― chain reaction
    1. (chemistry) reaction
      réaction chimique ― (please add an English translation of this usage example)
      réaction en chaîne ― chain reaction
    2. (physics)
      moteur à réaction ― jet engine
      avion à réaction ― jet plane
    3. (medicine)
      réaction de Maréchal ― (please add an English translation of this usage example)
  2. (politics) reaction (reactionary politics; a period in which reactionary thought or politics is resurgent or dominant)
